name: /last30days
summary: Agent skill that researches any topic across Reddit, X, YouTube, Hacker News, Polymarket and the web, then writes a grounded brief.
description: An AI-agent-led search engine scored by upvotes, likes and prediction-market odds rather than editors. It queries ~19 sources in parallel — Reddit, X, YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, Hacker News, Polymarket, GitHub, Digg, arXiv, Techmeme, LinkedIn, StockTwits, Threads, Pinterest, Xiaohongshu, Bluesky, Perplexity and the web — ranks by real engagement and has an agent judge synthesise one cited brief. Reddit, HN, Polymarket and GitHub work with zero config; other sources use your own keys or browser sessions.
contains: Reddit, HN, Polymarket and GitHub need no API key
ranks by upvotes, likes, views and real-money odds
discovery mode ranks 5-10 exploding topics with momentum labels
works with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Copilot, Gemini CLI and 50+ skills hosts
